data.spec: User correction: backend logic takes deterministic checks and executes mapped actions; no further UI work. Finish direct stock_low DeviceEvent → server catalogue/qty1/policy/snapshot planning without model, route canonical /api/sensor through fixed evaluator (bathroom legacy stock trigger becomes fixed config). Sound action becomes durable backend station-command queue via new office/facility_outputs.py. GET /api/devices/:board_id/actions {actions:StationAction[]}; POST .../actions/claim {consumer_id} atomically pending→dispatched returns {actions}; POST .../actions/:id/acknowledge {status:'delivered'|'failed',detail?}. StationAction {id,incident_id,board_id,kind:'sound',pattern:'attention',text,simulation,state:'pending'|'dispatched'|'delivered'|'failed'|'cancelled',consumer_id:null|string,created_at,updated_at,detail}. Sound commands stable per incident, no auto replay of dispatched outputs. Recovery cancels pending tones. Final feedback/hardware owner can claim this queue from existing single station bridge; do not create another serial owner. Existing feedback event feed stays owned by final-interface-feedback.
